---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
activities_with_50 <- attacks |>
  count(Activity, name = "incidents") |>
  filter(incidents >= 50) |>
  pull(Activity)

attacks_by_activity <- attacks |>
  filter(
    Activity %in% activities_with_50,
    Fatal_clean != "Unknown"
  ) |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean, name = "attacks")

ggplot(attacks_by_activity, aes(x = reorder(Activity, attacks), y = attacks, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal and non-fatal shark attacks by activity",
    x = "Activity",
    y = "Number of attacks",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
